verdicts.decision_note: The failed Amazon upload establishes the executable acceptance condition that the cover PDF must upload successfully to Amazon.
This is the first concrete runtime failure: the client attempted an Amazon upload and received an error.
The client requests a smaller PDF as a quality-preserving export option intended to reduce Amazon transfer timeouts or failures; no prior attribute becomes obsolete.
This is a target-specific implementation claim that the PDF was size-optimized without reducing print quality.
This is the first concrete verification that an actual cover PDF uploaded successfully to Amazon; the smaller optimized file remains available as a backup.
